title: Irish Stew with Cauliflower
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew made with tender chunks of beef and fresh cauliflower, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Season the beef with flour, salt, and pepper.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower florets to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the Irish stew seasoning and milk (if using). Serve hot.
